obligations.text: A release candidate is never published to crates.io, the npm registry or a container registry: `rustev-release publish` and the release workflow's `npm` job refuse a candidate tag or version before any upload.

A candidate run accepts only an annotated `vX.Y.Z-rc.N` tag that verifies against `tools/rustev-release/allowed_signers`, whose `X.Y.Z` is the release set's version, whose N is a positive integer without leading zeros, and whose commit is reachable from `main`; any other tag is refused before a build.

A candidate run performs every build and check of a release run (spec 031 3.9), requires the dispatched manifest's SHA-256 to equal the tag's `release-manifest-sha256:`, binds its artifacts to that manifest, and only then creates one GitHub pre-release of this repository holding exactly those artifacts, their checksums, SBOMs, the manifest and its signature.

sectionHeadings: 053: Signed release candidates published only as GitHub pre-releases (amends 031)
record.summary: A narrow amendment of approved spec 031 (3.9, 3.11, 3.12). It adds a release candidate: an owner-signed annotated tag `vX.Y.Z-rc.N` on a commit of `main`, built and checked by the release workflow exactly as a release is, and published only as a GitHub pre-release of this repository. A candidate never reaches crates.io, the npm registry or the container registry, never consumes spec 031 3.11's first-release authority, and is the identity a downstream consumer such as traveler (`statecrafting/tm`) pins with a Cargo git dependency. An integration rehearsal branch, `release/next`, is where each candidate commit is rehearsed before the owner signs it. Ratified by the owner on 2026-10-25 (A-55).
record.title: Signed release candidates published only as GitHub pre-releases (amends 031)
